---
title: "Comparison of Bacterial Classification between Captured and Non-captured Sequencing"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(vegan)
library(rprojroot)
library(eoffice) # For PPTX output

# Read data files
cap_file <- sprintf("%s/data/metaphlan_cap_merged_abundance_table.txt", find_rstudio_root_file())
nocap_file <- sprintf("%s/data/metaphlan_nocap_merged_abundance_table.txt", find_rstudio_root_file())

# Read data, skip first line
cap_data <- read.table(cap_file, header = TRUE, skip = 1)
nocap_data <- read.table(nocap_file, header = TRUE, skip = 1)

# List of samples
samples <- c("WS_0717_DXL", "WS_0717_HCZ", "WS_0717_RHN", "WS_0717_SLZ", "WS_0717_SY", "WS_0717_ZHGC",
             "WS_0724_DXL", "WS_0724_HCZ", "WS_0724_RHN", "WS_0724_SLZ", "WS_0724_SY", "WS_0724_ZHGC",
             "WS_0731_RHN", "WS_0731_SY", "WS_0731_ZHGC", "WS_0807_RHN", "WS_0807_SY", "WS_0807_ZHGC",
             "WS_0814_RHN", "WS_0814_SY", "WS_0814_ZHGC")

# Function to select samples and add suffix
select_and_add_suffix <- function(data, suffix) {
  new_data <- data %>% select(clade_name)
  for (sample in samples) {
    if (sample %in% colnames(data)) {
      new_data[[paste0(sample, suffix)]] <- data[[sample]]
    } else {
      new_data[[paste0(sample, suffix)]] <- 0
    }
  }
  return(new_data)
}

# Select samples and add suffixes
cap_selected <- select_and_add_suffix(cap_data, "_cap")
nocap_selected <- select_and_add_suffix(nocap_data, "_nocap")

# Combine data
combined_data <- full_join(cap_selected, nocap_selected, by = "clade_name") %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0)

# Function to extract taxonomic level data
extract_level <- function(data, level) {
  level_patterns <- list(
    "kingdom" = "k__[^|]+",
    "phylum" = "p__[^|]+",
    "class" = "c__[^|]+",
    "order" = "o__[^|]+",
    "family" = "f__[^|]+",
    "genus" = "g__[^|]+",
    "species" = "s__[^|]+")
  
  pattern <- level_patterns[[level]]
  if (is.null(pattern)) {
    stop("Invalid taxonomic level specified.")
  }
  
  data %>%
    filter(str_detect(clade_name, pattern) & str_count(clade_name, "\\|") == which(names(level_patterns) == level) - 1) %>%
    mutate(level_name = str_extract(clade_name, pattern)) %>%
    select(-clade_name) %>%
    group_by(level_name) %>%
    summarise_all(sum) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "level_name") %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame()
}

# Define taxonomic levels
levels <- c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species")

# Color palette
cns_colors <- c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4", "#91D1C2", "#DC0000", "#7E6148", "#B09C85")

# Loop through each taxonomic level
for (level in levels) {
  # Extract data for current level
  level_data <- extract_level(combined_data, level)
  
  # Check if data is empty
  if (nrow(level_data) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data available for level", level, ". Skipping this level."))
    next
  }
  
  # Split data into cap and non-cap groups
  cap_samples <- level_data[grep("_cap", rownames(level_data)), ]
  nocap_samples <- level_data[grep("_nocap", rownames(level_data)), ]
  
  # Ensure sample names match between groups
  cap_sample_names <- gsub("_cap", "", rownames(cap_samples))
  nocap_sample_names <- gsub("_nocap", "", rownames(nocap_samples))
  
  # Find common samples
  common_samples <- intersect(cap_sample_names, nocap_sample_names)
  
  # Subset data to include only common samples
  cap_samples_common <- cap_samples[cap_sample_names %in% common_samples, ]
  nocap_samples_common <- nocap_samples[nocap_sample_names %in% common_samples, ]
  
  # Sort samples to ensure order matches
  cap_samples_common <- cap_samples_common[order(cap_sample_names[cap_sample_names %in% common_samples]), ]
  nocap_samples_common <- nocap_samples_common[order(nocap_sample_names[nocap_sample_names %in% common_samples]), ]
  
  # Check if there are enough common samples
  if (nrow(cap_samples_common) < 3 || nrow(nocap_samples_common) < 3) {
    warning(paste("Not enough common samples for level", level, ". Skipping analysis."))
    next
  }
  
  # Perform PCoA on both groups
  cap_bray_dist <- vegdist(cap_samples_common, method = "bray")
  nocap_bray_dist <- vegdist(nocap_samples_common, method = "bray")
  
  # Replace NA and Inf values with 0
  cap_bray_dist[is.na(cap_bray_dist) | is.infinite(cap_bray_dist)] <- 0
  nocap_bray_dist[is.na(nocap_bray_dist) | is.infinite(nocap_bray_dist)] <- 0
  
  # Perform PCoA
  cap_pcoa <- cmdscale(cap_bray_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  nocap_pcoa <- cmdscale(nocap_bray_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  
  # Check if PCoA results are valid
  if (is.null(cap_pcoa$points) || nrow(cap_pcoa$points) == 0 || 
      is.null(nocap_pcoa$points) || nrow(nocap_pcoa$points) == 0) {
    warning(paste("PCoA result for level", level, "is invalid. Skipping this level."))
    next
  }
  
  # Prepare data frames for plotting
  cap_pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(cap_pcoa$points)
  colnames(cap_pcoa_df) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
  cap_pcoa_df$sample <- rownames(cap_samples_common)
  cap_pcoa_df$method <- "HybCapSeq"
  
  nocap_pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(nocap_pcoa$points)
  colnames(nocap_pcoa_df) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
  nocap_pcoa_df$sample <- rownames(nocap_samples_common)
  nocap_pcoa_df$method <- "MetaT"
  
  # Perform Procrustes analysis for plotting
  proc_result <- procrustes(cap_pcoa$points, nocap_pcoa$points, scale = TRUE)
  
  # Perform Protest analysis for statistical significance
  set.seed(1234)
  protest_result <- protest(cap_pcoa$points, nocap_pcoa$points, permutations = 999, scale = TRUE)
  
  # Extract protest results
  protest_corr <- protest_result$t0  # Correlation coefficient r
  protest_p_value <- protest_result$signif  # P-value
  
  # Create transformed data frame for plotting
  transformed_nocap <- as.data.frame(proc_result$Yrot)
  colnames(transformed_nocap) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
  transformed_nocap$sample <- rownames(nocap_samples_common)
  transformed_nocap$method <- "MetaT"  # Renamed from "MetaT (Transformed)" for legend
  
  # Combine original and transformed data for plotting
  plot_data <- rbind(
    cap_pcoa_df %>% select(PC1, PC2, sample, method),
    transformed_nocap %>% select(PC1, PC2, sample, method)
  )
  
  # Extract sampling site information
  plot_data$sampling_site <- gsub(".*(DXL|HCZ|RHN|SLZ|SY|ZHGC).*", "\\1", plot_data$sample)
  
  # Calculate PC1 and PC2 percentages for both groups
  cap_pc1_percent <- round(100 * cap_pcoa$eig[1] / sum(cap_pcoa$eig), 2)
  cap_pc2_percent <- round(100 * cap_pcoa$eig[2] / sum(cap_pcoa$eig), 2)
  
  # Determine plot limits for annotation positioning
  x_min <- min(plot_data$PC1)
  x_max <- max(plot_data$PC1)
  y_min <- min(plot_data$PC2)
  y_max <- max(plot_data$PC2)
  
  # Create annotation text
  annotation_text <- paste(
    "Protest Analysis:\n",
    "r = ", format(protest_corr, digits = 3), "\n",
    "P = ", ifelse(protest_p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", format(protest_p_value, digits = 3)),
    sep = ""
  )
  
  # Plot Procrustes superimposition
  procrustes_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = method, shape = sampling_site)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    # Add arrows connecting original and transformed points
    geom_segment(
      data = data.frame(
        x = cap_pcoa_df$PC1,
        y = cap_pcoa_df$PC2,
        xend = transformed_nocap$PC1,
        yend = transformed_nocap$PC2,
        sampling_site = gsub(".*(DXL|HCZ|RHN|SLZ|SY|ZHGC).*", "\\1", cap_pcoa_df$sample),
        method = "Connection"
      ),
      aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, group = sampling_site),
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.5,
      color = "gray50"
    ) +
    # Add r and p value annotation
    annotate(
      "text", 
      x = x_min + 0.05 * (x_max - x_min),  # Position on left side
      y = y_max - 0.05 * (y_max - y_min),  # Position on top
      label = annotation_text,
      hjust = 0, 
      vjust = 1, 
      size = 4,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black",
      fill = alpha("white", 0.8),
      box.colour = "gray80",
      box.linetype = 1,
      box.size = 0.3
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1 (", cap_pc1_percent, "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", cap_pc2_percent, "%)"),
      color = "Sequencing Method",
      shape = "Sampling Site"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("HybCapSeq" = cns_colors[1], "MetaT" = cns_colors[2], "Connection" = "gray50"),
      labels = c("HybCapSeq", "MetaT")  # Ensure legend shows correct labels
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(DXL = 15, HCZ = 16, RHN = 17, SLZ = 18, SY = 8, ZHGC = 9)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_blank(),  # Remove title
      plot.subtitle = element_blank(),  # Remove subtitle
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm")  # Adjust plot margins
    )
  
  # Save plot as PDF
  pdf_output_path <- sprintf("%s/charts/Procrustes_%s_Bray_Curtis.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file(), level)
  ggsave(pdf_output_path, procrustes_plot, width = 8, height = 8)
  
  # Save plot as PPTX
  pptx_output_path <- sprintf("%s/charts/Procrustes_%s_Bray_Curtis.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file(), level)
  topptx(procrustes_plot, filename = pptx_output_path, height = 8, width = 8)
  
  # Print results
  cat("Level:", level, "\n")
  cat("Protest Correlation (r):", protest_corr, "\n")
  cat("Protest P-value:", ifelse(protest_p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001", format(protest_p_value, digits = 3)), "\n\n")
}
```
